ADDED TO CALENDAR FOR THE COURT TO ADDRESS SERVICE AND PROOF OF SERVICE ISSUES. HEARING SET FOR FEB-24-2026 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF SYLVIA RICHARDSO IS NOT PRESENT. APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT COMCAST PRESENTED BY NILES HALL. DEFENDANT APPEARED AT THE FEB-24-2026 HEARING. UPON EXAMINATION OF THE PROOF OF SERVICE, IT INDICATED THAT THE SERVICE DATE OF THE CLAIM WAS JAN-15-2026 WITH A HEARING DATE OF APR-28-2026. THE PLAINTIFF'S CASE WAS RESET TO APR-28-2026 ON FEB-17-2026. THEREFORE, THE COURT DISMISSES THE PLAINTIFF'S CASE WITHOUT PREJUDICE. JUDGE: JOSH M. FREDRICKS; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
